newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Handlowy eyes tight spread for eurobond - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Polish Handlowy eyes tight spread for eurobond - CEO.

text.p: The price of Polish Bank Handlowy's April issue of up to $200 million eurobonds is likely to have a much narrower spread over similar maturity U.S. treasuries than last year's issue, Handlowy's head said.
"We are sure that this year the spread over similar maturity U.S. treasuries will be much lower than last year," Cezary Stypulkowski told a news conference.
Stypulkowski said the issue of the bonds, of up to five years maturity, would be managed by JP Morgan as in 1996.
In 1996 Handlowy, which has a Baa3 investment grade from Moody's Investor Service, sold $100 million of three-year bonds at 88 basis points above U.S. treasuries, Stypulkowski said.
